lines: In the heart of Gosha Village, opposite Inageya, was a little gazebo.
It was a plain space, with only a bench and a bulletin board, but it had become a minor relaxation spot in town.
In front of that bulletin board, a crowd of people had formed for some reason.
「Was this what that show was called?」
The one who had called out to me was Shinohara Mari, a classmate and Earth Escape user.
「What's wrong? What the hell's with this crowd?」
「The thing is, you see, the new school year edition of the Gosha Student Newspaper has been posted again.」
It was something that Gosha Academy's Newspaper Club published every month, carrying things like notifications, the school's achievements, a calendar of events in Gosha Village, etc.
In this town, with its small population, it also served a role akin to a neighbourhood association newsletter, and so got posted in the village, like this.
But to be frank, in recent years, since the net had grown, few people even paid attention to it.
「I don't think that's anything worth making such a racket about, though...... What the hell's been printed in it?」
Pushing people aside, I went up in front of the bulletin board.
「The new year edition of the Gosha Student Newspaper comes out on April 1st again.」
「During this busy period for producing that, the whole Newspaper Club came down with colds.」
「That's awful, but...... I've never made a newspaper before.」
「Moreover, April 1st is only one week away, isn't it?」
「Well, that's true...... It's unfortunate, but I guess we won't have an issue this year.」
「I expect Nanase-san will be disappointed, though.」
「Nanase-san is a Paper Spirit user, so she loves paper, you see.」
「She mentioned that she very much likes the size, colour and smell of that newspaper's pages.」
「And that it was thrilling for familiar Gosha information to be printed on that paper.」
「......Mai-chan does have a paper fetish, doesn't she......?」
「（The newspaper that Mai-chan's been looking forward to, huh......?）」
「（I don't want to see her disappointed face...... Hmm, but...... Hmm......）」
「――All right, understood! I'll give it a shot!!!」
「Thank you! You're a lifesaver. Well, I'll count on you, all right?」
「So, now that I've taken this on, I have to do my best!」
「When it comes to making newspapers...... you start with interviewing people first, right?」
「So on that basis, Kiryuu-sensei, do you have any scoops?!」
「Hmm, material for a newspaper, you say. But why ask me?」
「I was thinking, if it's Kiryuu-sensei, the genius Demonologist who's treated Asagi-sensei and Sakura-sensei, and who all the students rely on, he's bound to have some kind of scoop, right?」
「I see, is that so?! Wahaha! You know me well, don't you, Shinohara?」
「So, what kind of information do you want? Murasaki's menstrual cycle? Her ECG waveform? How many millimetres Murasaki's hair grows in a month?」
「I could give you the scoop on my flash marriage to Murasaki! I've booked the wedding hall and arranged for our new home!! All that's left is to get the OK from her!」
「I don't need anything too crazy...... I mean, private! Or any uncertain information, either!」
「What, that's not it? Then what kind of information do you want?」
「Ummm, for example, it seems like it's been a long time since Kiryuu-sensei came to Gosha.」
「Do you have any plans to take part in the town's annual festivities, or anything like that?」
「Ohh～, “that”, huh? “That”, you mean? Well, I'm thinking about it, in the near future.」
「Eh?! Is that true?! If that's true, this is a big scoop! It'll be the front-page story!」
「That's right, that's right! Of course it will! Everyone's looking forward to it, after all.」
「Yes, thank you very much for the valuable information!」
「The day that I join your festival, the Taima-stones shall runneth over, and everyone will be behind me!」
「I'm sure men and women of all ages will want me! I'm devoted solely to Murasaki, though! Waaahahaha!」
「For some reason I haven't gotten any offers yet, but I suppose they're holding back.」
「She left, huh? It's understandable. You have to make an article out of this big scoop as soon as you can, right?」
「I was able to get some good material right away. Shall I try looking for information in the village too?」
「When you want information, you go to the tavern. It's a fundamental of RPGs, right?」
「So, Senpai! Have you got any kind of material that would make for a newspaper article?」
「Newspaper, eh～......? If you're lookin' for a special feature for your newspaper, it's gotta be “That”.」
「What, you don't get what I mean by odds? Well, to put it so it's easy to understand, it's like a popularity ranking/betting kinda thing, see?」
「I know, right? “Should I go for it? Do I bet on a long shot?” Can't beat the thrill of that.」
「I'll try and look into that right away! Thank you very much!」

「I'm Minasaki～♪
The strong and clever yatagarasu～♪」

「I'm cute and charming♪
The genius succubus, Lilim-chan～♪」

「「Today's gonna be fun～♪
It's a good day for pranks～～♪」」
「Totally! That Fuuma, living in a crappy rural town like this...」
「I'm sick of watching TV, too. We only get three channels, and it's all safe, inoffensive shows.」
「Don't the people of this town get tired of that kind of TV?」
「It just came to me! Wouldn't it be fun if we make a channel ourselves?!」
「Ohhhh! That sounds like it would be a good way to kill time!」
「Hoho! Then, here, we do it like...... (Mumble-mumble)」
「Yeah, this'll get high ratings for sure!」
「Then we'll use those ratings as bait, and rake in the sponsorship money!」
「I thought I saw some people, so I was going to try and interview them, but I was seeing things, huh......?」
「This might be divine intervention. Let's put it to use in creating the newspaper right away!」
「I see...... I feel like I basically got the gist.」
After hearing Mari's story, I held my head in my hands.
「It's unusually crowded, huh? Is there something neat going on?」
